title: No Grid - A Creative Conversation Series
time_text: Wednesday, October 7 • 4 PM - 8 PM (doors at 3:30 PM); description says 4:00-7:00PM
description:
Taking place across multiple spaces, NO GRID invites audiences to hear directly from artists, discover new perspectives and connect.

No Grid: A Creative Conversation Series by Jason Snell. Part of Cincinnati Art Week 2026.

Wednesday, October 7, 2026
4:00-7:00PM
Over-the-Rhine | Cincinnati, OH

The evening will feature:

Five artist conversations across three unique venues within a two-block walk
Three venue expereinces
A few unexpected moments of surprise and delight along the route
Complimentary beverages and light bites throughout the evening

A closing gathering at OFFSITE - a pop-up Cincinnati Art Week experience.
notes: Organizer on Eventbrite: Cincy Nice. Three venues within a two-block walk: CAW Art Market (1417 Main St), MOTR and OFFSITE (per Jason Snell's Instagram post of 2026-09-15). Times conflict across sources: Eventbrite event time 16:00–20:00 (doors 15:30); Eventbrite description "4:00-7:00PM"; Instagram "BEGINNING AT 4PM"; CAW draft schedule "6–9 PM". Eventbrite says "Five artist conversations across three unique venues"; lineup lists six names incl. host Jason Snell. Eventbrite "Good to know": in person, duration 240 minutes, doors 15:30, parking "not_available" (Eventbrite's code for no on-site parking).
